03 / BRING YOUR OWN BUG

One command.
A fresh perspective.

Compile with -g, run Memcheck,
then open your report here.

TERMINAL
valgrind --leak-check=full
--show-leak-kinds=all
--track-origins=yes
--log-file=report.log ./app
